options.text: Talk about the Murder Mystery Quest

steps.npc: I hear you're pretty smart to have solved the Sinclair Murder!
Howdy! Thanks for buying all that low alcohol beer from me! Now I have the funds to whip up a new batch of my patented multipurpose poison!
Maybe I can take your name and add it to my mailing list for potential purchasers of Peter Potter's patented multipurpose poison?
